बॉस, रणबीर कपूर ने अपनी अपकमिंग फिल्म के लिए ऐसी ज़बरदस्त तैयारी की है कि जानकर आपके होश उड़ जाएंगे! 🏹✨

1. Nitesh Tiwari द्वारा निर्देशित और Namit Malhotra द्वारा प्रोड्यूस की गई फिल्म Ramayana: Part 1 में Lord Rama का रोल निभाने के लिए Ranbir Kapoor ने शूटिंग से 1.5 साल पहले ही ट्रेनिंग शुरू कर दी थी।
2. Review Nation के साथ इंटरव्यू में Ranbir ने बताया कि तीरंदाजी की सही तकनीक सीखने के लिए उन्होंने एक Indian Olympian के साथ 18 महीने काम किया और New York में भी क्लासेस लीं।
3. इतना ही नहीं, Planet of the Apes और Superman Returns फेम एक्शन डायरेक्टर Terry Notary की वर्कशॉप में Ranbir ने सांस लेने की तकनीक, बॉडी लैंग्वेज, चलने का तरीका और पेड़ पर चढ़ना भी सीखा।
4. 27 October को Los Angeles के Academy Museum of Motion Pictures में प्रीमियर के बाद Ranbir ने अपनी इस फिजिकल और स्पिरिचुअल तैयारी पर खुलकर बात की।
5. इस महाकाव्य फिल्म में Sai Pallavi सीता, Yash रावण, Sunny Deol हनुमान और Ravie Dubey लक्ष्मण के किरदार में नजर आएंगे। यह फिल्म 5 November 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी।

क्या आप Ranbir Kapoor को इस आइकॉनिक अवतार में देखने के लिए उत्सुक हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर लिखें! 👇

ctx.title: Ranbir Kapoor reveals he trained with an Indian Olympian archer for 18 months before filming Ramayana
ctx.summary: Ranbir Kapoor spent 18 months preparing to play Lord Rama in Ramayana, attending workshops on movement, breathing and physicality.
ctx.text:
Ranbir Kapoor -starrer Ramayana : Part 1 is all set to hit the big screen on Thursday, November 5. The film had its premiere at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles on October 27. Following the premiere, Ranbir spoke in an interview about how he prepared for the physical aspects of playing Lord Rama, including learning archery and undergoing special workshops.
During an interaction with Review Nation, Ranbir shared that he began training for the role nearly a year and a half before filming began. He revealed that he worked with an Indian Olympian to learn the right archery techniques and also attended workshops focused on movement, breathing and physicality.
Speaking about his preparation, Ranbir said, "Lord Rama was a great archer. So, about a year and a half before we started filming, I worked with an Indian Olympian on the right technique. I was in New York for some time, and I also took some classes. The deeper part, however, was to understand the essence of who Lord Rama is. You can read as much as you want and see different interpretations, but eventually, what soul are you putting into the character? I could be playing Lord Rama, but the soul is mine. How do I change that? How do I bring a new soul?"
The actor also spoke about working with action director Terry Notary, known for his work on films such as the Planet of the Apes franchise, X2 (2003), Superman Returns (2006)and others. Ranbir revealed that the workshops conducted by Terry went beyond combat training and focused on helping actors understand movement and body language.
"Terry Notary had workshops where he taught us breathing techniques, how to walk, how to climb a tree and things like that. As actors, we are so lucky and grateful that we get to learn new skills with new movies. But Ramayana will always be special because it is the most beloved story with beloved characters. So doing all of this was awesome," Ranbir said.
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana: Part 1 is a cinematic adaptation of the Indian epic and the first instalment of a planned two-part saga. Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, while Sai Pallavi essays the role of Sita and Yash portrays Ravana. The film also stars Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. Ramayana: Part 1 is scheduled to release worldwide in cinemas on November 5, 2026.
